title: Chapter 1250
text:
"This mission has finally been completed. It's not difficult, but it took too long."

Han Xiao looked down at the back of his hand, only to see a mark slowly forming. The pattern was exactly the same as the one on Hella's hand.

He looked up and saw Onicelu smiling at him.

"This is the Mark of the Underworld. You can borrow a portion of the Underworld's power. Without your help, the Underworld won't be able to return to its peak. I don't have anything to repay you with, so this is just a small token of my appreciation."

"Got it. I'll make good use of your body … cough, the Underworld."

Han Xiao coughed.

The Underworld was Onicelu's body. Did this count as' I have nothing to repay you with, so I can only repay you with my body '?

No, no, I'm a decent person … Please use more strength.

Suppressing his desire to complain, Han Xiao felt the Mark of the Underworld. Strands of black air flowed out of the mark, wrapped around his hand, and took a little bit of the Underworld's energy.

This was the second secondary dimension that had a connection with him. In comparison, the mental connection of the Void Dimension was more advanced, while the Underworld dimension could only borrow a portion of its energy through a medium. However, there was still a slight bonus.

At the same time, due to the uniqueness of the Underworld dimension, he could choose to absorb the souls of the enemies he killed through the Mark of the Underworld and turn them into Hero Spirits under Hella.

When Aurora stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm and the Underworld gained the ability to revive, he should be able to use the Mark of the Underworld to summon Hero Spirits to battle. However, this would consume Hella and Aurora's energy.

In this case, the more Hero Spirits there are in the Underworld, the more benefits I'll receive.

Han Xiaoxin mumbled to himself for a while before looking at the other reward, Onicelu's Character Summon Card.

The effect of [Ten Thousand Soul Stream] was extremely overbearing. It was actually immune to all mental attacks.

Although it could only be used once, it was undoubtedly a trump card that could be used at the right time.

While he was checking the mission rewards, the Underworld was undergoing a huge change. On the other side, Hella had already started communicating with the seven Hero Spirit Kings.

After the seven of them admitted defeat, the process of reaching a consensus was much smoother.

"From today onwards, you will be part of the Black Star Corps. Do you understand?" Hella said in a deep voice.

"No problem. If His Excellency Black Star wants us to go east, we definitely won't go west. If he wants us to go to the sky, we definitely won't go to the ground!"

The seven of them patted their chests and promised. Their attitude changed very skillfully.

"They were like this in the past too?" Han Xiao was curious.

Onicelu said in a low voice, "The previous master didn't have many thoughts of expanding the Underworld. Of the seven people, two provoked the two sisters and were captured. They were tortured and had lost their edge long ago. Three of them escaped and owed the two sisters a favor. The other two came voluntarily, crying and begging the two sisters to accept them … So, you can imagine what they are like."

"Impressive …" Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

From the two sisters' behavior, it could be seen that they did whatever they wanted and had no intention of taking responsibility. The reason why there were so many people in the Underworld was probably that many people begged to join regardless of whether the two sisters were reliable or not in order to achieve eternal life. They did not even give up their freedom. Obviously, they did not have much integrity left.

Han Xiao smelled the scent of someone in the same field.

This was an expert!

Just sitting at home, leeks came like clouds. It was clear that making a platform was better than making a product.

As expected, the essence of all wealth accumulation was to raise leeks and harvest leeks. Without the contribution of leeks, there would be no happiness for oligarchs.

Although the seven Hero Spirit Kings joined for different reasons, after years of influence, they did not want to give up eternal life and did not dare to offend the master of the Underworld. Furthermore, they were hoping that the Lord of Life would summon them so that they could go to the outside world.

This kind of personality could be described as being submissive to the inside world and punching the outside world! Fighting the inside world and fighting the outside world!

Currently, the strongest among the Hero Spirit Kings was a Primordial One called Rega. According to the information, his Energy Rank was around 65000 Ona. He had not reached the peak of the Beyond Grade A level, but he was above average among ordinary Beyond Grade As. With an immortal body, his actual strength would be increased by half a level.

Han Xiao thought for a while, stepped forward, and asked, "Do you know anything about the Sanctums?"

In the past, he wanted to ask about the Sanctums from the Underworld Hero Spirits, but the cooperation with the Holy Covenant had been further developed. They had been searching for the 'key to open the Third Sanctum' again, so he did not need the help of the Underworld Hero Spirits.

Furthermore, these Hero Spirits definitely did not know as much about the Sanctums as the Holy Covenant, so Han Xiao was just trying his luck.

"Sanctums? I didn't expect you … boss to know about this too. "

The seven Hero Spirit Kings looked over at the same time. Their expressions were slightly complicated, as if they had thought of something in the past.

"Before we entered the Underworld, there was a rumor among a small number of Beyond Grade As that some people could sense a special existence outside of spacetime by chance. Some people called it the Sanctums, but most people did not have such an experience and could not verify its authenticity. It has always been considered a rumor," one of the Hero Spirit Kings said.

"Some people say that the Sanctums are a step higher, some say that the Sanctums hide all the technology from ancient times, and some say that the Sanctums can bring people back from the dead. No one knows whether it's true or not," another said.

Rega sighed, shook his head, and said, "We don't know much about them.

"We actually don't know much, but during the exploration era, I remember that a group of Beyond Grade As formed an organization. They seemed to want to use the Sanctums to be reborn in the future. We didn't think it was reliable, so we didn't join. They should have failed by now."

Han Xiao raised his brows. "What's the name of that organization?"

"I think it's called the Holy Covenant."

"…"

Han Xiao pursed his lips, not knowing what expression to make.

It was indeed the Holy Covenant. They did not fail at all. The plan was a great success!

Of course, most of the credit went to Oathkeeper. He did not know what good things those revived Primordial Ones did in their previous lives to let them meet such a reliable partner.

However, it was best not to tell this to the seven Hero Spirit Kings. Once they entered the Underworld, they would probably never be able to revive through the Sanctums. If they knew about this, these seven d * mn people would probably regret it to death.

It was better to let them continue to think that the Holy Covenant organization had failed. Not telling them this cruel truth was also to protect the health of the leeks …

No matter what, these Hero Spirits had a different type of eternal life. Although they walked on different paths, they still reached the other side in the end.

Various thoughts flashed through his mind. Han Xiao suppressed his emotions and did not speak anymore. He listened to Hella and the seven Hero Spirit Kings talk by the side.

After chatting for a while, the seven Hero Spirit Kings bade farewell and left to lead the Hero Spirits.

Seeing the seven of them leave, Hella turned around and asked, "What do you think of them?"

Han Xiao smiled. "Although their personalities are a little off, their strength can't be faked. The Underworld is an extremely strong armed force. Although it's useless now, as long as Aurora maintains her current growth rate, she'll step into the Beyond Grade A sooner or later. By then, there won't be many people in the universe who can threaten you two sisters … Speaking of which, the Underworld is like a special Universal Treasure exclusive to you two. Tsk, I'm so envious."

In his previous life, Hella did not receive this inheritance and wasted it. This time, as long as nothing unexpected happened, the two sisters would be able to enter the top echelon of the explored universe.

As long as Aurora stepped into the Beyond Grade A realm, the two sisters would soar.

"How do I compare to you? Can I beat you? "Hella's eyes sparkled.

"What, are you trying to usurp the throne?" Han Xiao joked. "Dream on. When the time comes, I'll still be able to beat your ass until it blossoms."

"Humph, I don't believe it." Hella's lips curled up slightly. "We'll only know after we try."

She secretly decided that she would not do anything when she returned. She would urge Aurora to train every day so that the Underworld could recover as soon as possible.

After finishing her business, Hila felt Han Xiao's condensed and powerful aura, and the urge to fight came up. She secretly felt her hands itching, so she sent out a challenge.

"You have nothing to do now. Do you want to fight with me?"

"The Underworld has just recovered. You still have a lot of things to do. It's best if you organize a list of Hero Spirits. We'll talk about sparring next time." Han Xiao waved his hands.

"That's true." Hella had no choice but to endure it.

Han Xiao said a few words, put on the King, and teleported away from the Underworld.

Returning to the office in Black Star Palace, Han Xiao changed into casual clothes, summoned Philip, and added the information of the Underworld to the confidential plan file.

While recording, he secretly analyzed. Although it was good news, his heart was heavy.

"This way, I'll have another powerful secret force in my hands. In the future, Hella and her sister's position in the universe will definitely skyrocket, enough to become the upper echelons of the Beyond Grade A Association.

"When the Holy Covenant comes out, the entire universe will have two recovery paths. One is the Sanctum, and the other is the Underworld. The Beyond Grade As will have room to choose, but currently, only Oathkeeper and I know that the Sanctum is an infinite recovery. The others think that it's a one-time thing, so we can't rule out the possibility that some people will switch to the Underworld because of the wrong information … However, for Supers below Beyond Grade A, they only have one choice, which is the Underworld.

"And these two recovery methods are both related to me. I'll definitely become the focus of the entire universe and the focus of the three Universal Civilizations. Right now, the dynasty is controlled by the hardliners, and the new president of the Radiant Federation seems to be a muscular man … Tsk, the situation is not optimistic. The importance of the Sanctum and the Underworld is much higher than the Evolution Cube. The advanced civilizations won't let it go this time. I might become the starting point of the storm.

Once it reaches a certain stage, it can't be stopped. The advanced civilizations that represent the strength of the group will never stop targeting the Beyond Grade As … "

Han Xiao frowned and pondered. He had to consider the future.

There were too many problems that could not be solved due to the intricate relationship of interests. He suddenly had a vague but bold idea in his mind.

If the Beyond Grade A Association and all the Beyond Grade A organizations merged and transformed, forming a new organization that completely separated the ordinary people from the Supers …

This might be a path that he had never imagined before. A revolution that would overturn the world would cause many people to die.

With his current position, he already had the ability to control the direction of the universe. Many things that seemed impossible were no longer unimaginable.

However, once he decided to change, it would affect the lives of billions of living beings. He only had thoughts and had no intention of acting on them.

The shadow of the World Tree was still hanging over the explored universe. Now was not the time to make such plans.

"After dealing with the external enemies, I'll decide based on the situation. I really don't want to take this step …"

Han Xiao exhaled and suppressed the surging waves in his heart, suppressing these thoughts in the deepest part of his heart.

At this time, his communicator suddenly rang.

Beep beep beep …

He took out his communicator and looked at it. It was a call from Sylvia.

"Army Commander, the Red Empire has sent an official letter. They will send an emissary to inspect the cultural transformation of the Kunde Race. If it meets the standards, they can consider opening up a portion of the sealed area and let a group of people enter the galactic society."

"Oh? It's only been less than thirty years, right? It's much earlier than expected. "

Han Xiao's eyes lit up.

He still remembered the mission of the Kunde Race. Modo had already lost everything, and only the cultural transformation requirement had not been completed.

As long as he completed this mission, he would be able to truly obtain the few abilities that he had always wanted.
